transcript.text: Hello, welcome back to the On Print Shop Add on Modules tutorial series.
In this video we will be talking about the one Click automation module.
In the printing industry, it is a major challenge to manage the coming offline orders.
Around 70% to 80% of orders that come offline need manual processes to create orders, personalized artwork approval, and print production.
Any delay in any process means you failed to deliver on time and do not meet the timelines committed to your customers.
With on Print Shop One Click Automation, you can simply push orders into the system with artwork creation.
This will reduce dependency on the designers and take the edge off manual labor.
So let's see how you can do that.
Log into your Store admin panel, navigate to the Orders section, and then click on Add New Order.
Using this screen, you can add orders individually.
To get started with Bulk Order Import, you will have to get in touch with the technical team or write to us at support at on printshop.com.
Once Bulk Order Import is enabled for your on Print Shop store, you'll see an Import Orders button.
Importing bulk orders is a six step process which involves downloading a sample file, filling in the details, mapping fields and finally importing the orders.
Let's check each step in detail.
In the first step, you need to download the sample file to add the data.
As you click on the Download file button, a sample CSV file will be downloaded and then click on the next button to move to the second step of the process.
The second step is the help screen which shows how you need to fill up the data in the Excel or CSV sheet downloaded.
The text which is displayed in red font is mandatory or the required fields.
So in the sheet you must add the e-mail ID, product quantity, address 1 state and country for entering the value in all the columns, you can refer to this screen.
To specify the country, you need to search for country, add and then add its country code in the column.
Once you have added all the data, you can save and close the file.
After this click on the next button and in the third step you have to upload the data file.

For this, first of all select the user type from the store drop down and then if the orders you are importing contain any template reference, select the with template reference or else select the custom order in the shipping method and payment method fields.
The selected methods will be applied to all the orders being imported.
These fields will list all the enabled shipping and payment methods in the system.
Select the order status and it will be applied to all the imported orders.
If the orders have a template associated with them, then enable this setting to save those designs into the customers portfolio.
Tick the Notify button to send an e-mail to customers.
After selections, click on the Upload File button to upload the Save data file.
Click on the Next button and it will move you to the fourth step.
Here we have a mapping tab for order details wherein you can map the database fields with the Import Orders excel sheet fields.

You will find 2 columns Database field which contains the database fields saved in the system and Description which contains a list of all the excel sheet fields for you to map with the database fields.
For the PDF block templates, there will be a tab assigned to each template.
You can map the templates field with the excel file fields.
If there is more than one page in the PDF block template, then you'll see page information while mapping fields.
Once you are done mapping the fields with the description, click on the next button in the 5th step.
The system will display the imported data summary.
Here you can see the number of invalid orders and check the invalid fields which will be indicated by a warning sign.
You can correct the same from the file and upload the file again to proceed further.
Once it is good to go, click on the next button in the last step.
You'll see the order summary.
This will contain customer details, order product details, design, shipping address, shipping and payment details, and order total.
You can also check the design if you have added the orders with template personalization.
If there's a new customer to be added, then you'll see an indication for the same.
After the review, click on the import button from the top right corner.
The system will display a warning message asking if you are sure to import orders.
Click OK now you'll be redirected to the order screen with all the new orders added and that's it.
Importing all your orders in bulk to the on print shop is a breeze.
If you have any questions, our support executives are here to help.
Just reach out through live chat on on printshop.com.
Thanks for tuning in.
